name: Kentik
tagline: Kentik is a network observability platform that analyzes traffic flow data, BGP routing, and cloud network performance to detect anomalies and diagnose outages. Its AI-driven analytics engine flags unusual traffic patterns and ties them to specific applications or peers. Network engineers use it to troubleshoot incidents faster across hybrid and multi-cloud networks.
